notes.title: SHOOTING STAR VR Patch V1.1.3
notes.notes:
Patch Note(V1.1.3)

Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43915075/599f4c2db4afcc75bd4e9cbe5a8b5b6e09b4bbbd.png
Before

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43915075/d7622d42409785c788b5eb4fd752784e0ba7b1c5.png

 Added numbers to the Stars.

notes.title: Urgent Update(Patch v1.1.4)
notes.notes:
Revised button mapping for dialogue box on VIVE and Valve Index controllers.
   - On VIVE controllers, use the 'menu button' on the right-hand controller.
   - On Index controllers, use the 'A button' on the right-hand controller.

notes.title: SHOOTING STAR VR Patch V1.1.2
notes.notes:
Patch Note(V1.1.2)

Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43915075/7440b9ee3d5534e2ec634e3b6379942b39c036e9.png
Before

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43915075/51634de7e1dfcca36a96529e08eea76211a66433.png
After



 Changed the UI clock icon.
 Modified the hit reaction animation.
 Added Fail reasons upon game over.
 Adjusted the portal in the tutorial to face the player.
 Updated the option button and changed it to display "Apply".


Fixes


 Fixed a bug where the first stage was not cleared in some situations.
 Fixed a bug where the leaderboard scores were not reflected in some situations.
 Fixed a bug where the bow disappeared after returning to the lobby in active bow mode, allowing gameplay to continue.


Best wishes,
SHOOTING STAR VR Team

notes.title: SHOOTING STAR VR Patch V1.1.0
notes.notes:
Patch Note(V1.1.0)

Changes

 Multi-Language Support
  - Before we only support English but now we support various languages.
  - Now we support Simplified Chinese.
  - Now we support Korean.
  - Now we support Japanese.
    
 Modify UI Interaction effect.
 - We noticed that players had a hard time recognizing that they were interacting with the UI.


Fixes

 Fixed tutorial Image scale.
 - Some Images in Tutorial did not adequate compared to other images. Therefore we fixed scales to harmonize.


Best wishes,
SHOOTING STAR VR Team
